description: Hudson fans Tuf-Lite II 3000H Series Hub fan assemblies offer years of cost effective, reliable service. Cooling Tower replacement parts from ICST.

sections.heading: Hudson Fans Tuf-Lite II 3000H Series Hub
paragraphs: Adjustable Pitch Fan Assembly 6′ Through 14′ Diameter. Blade Counts from 4 to 15.

Hudson Tuf-Lite II 3000H Series Hub (White, previously Blue) fan blades are made from fiberglass-reinforced vinyl-ester resin, which offers a high strength-to-weight ratio and ultraviolet and corrosion resistance. An elastomeric blade/holder joint cover prevents moisture from entering the blade.
